title: [GMCP 203.023.05] Interoperability and quality: Service adapters and generated MCP surfaces
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-023-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, command and native-library adapters can generate reviewable MCP tools/resources with stable names, precise schemas, pagination, auth mapping, rate limits, idempotency and redaction. Generated artifacts are reproducible, diffable and policy-scanned; unsupported semantics fail generation rather than producing unsafe generic shells. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
